mapper.select:
SELECT br.*
GROUP BY br.id
ORDER BY br.id ASCDESC
ORDER BY br.${dto.sortType.name} ASCDESC

SELECT t.record_category AS recordCategory, SUM(t.amount) AS totalAmount FROM ( SELECT br.*
GROUP BY br.id ) t GROUP BY t.record_category

select
record_date as recordDate DATE_FORMAT(record_date, '%Y-%m') as recordDate
,IFNULL(sum(amount), 0) as amount from bookkeeping_records where deleted = 0 and record_category = #{dto.recordCategory} AND record_date BETWEEN #{dto.currentStartMonth} AND #{dto.currentEndMonth}
AND is_statistics = 1
AND dictionary_snapshot_status=1 AND record_type_name IS NULL AND dictionary_snapshot_status=0
AND dictionary_snapshot_status=1 AND CAST(record_type_name AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{name} AS BINARY)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookkeeping_record_tag_snapshot tag_filter WHERE tag_filter.record_id=bookkeeping_records.id AND tag_filter.dict_type=CASE WHEN bookkeeping_records.record_category=1 THEN 4001 ELSE 4011 END AND CAST(tag_filter.tag_name AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{name} AS BINARY))
group by record_date group by DATE_FORMAT(record_date, '%Y-%m')

SELECT MAX(record_type_name) AS record_type_name, dictionary_snapshot_status, IFNULL(sum(amount), 0) AS amount, count(*) AS recordNum FROM bookkeeping_records WHERE deleted = 0 AND record_category = #{dto.recordCategory} AND record_date BETWEEN #{dto.currentStartMonth} AND #{dto.currentEndMonth}
AND is_statistics = 1
AND dictionary_snapshot_status=1 AND record_type_name IS NULL AND dictionary_snapshot_status=0
AND dictionary_snapshot_status=1 AND CAST(record_type_name AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{item} AS BINARY)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookkeeping_record_tag_snapshot tag_filter WHERE tag_filter.record_id=bookkeeping_records.id AND tag_filter.dict_type=CASE WHEN bookkeeping_records.record_category=1 THEN 4001 ELSE 4011 END AND CAST(tag_filter.tag_name AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{name} AS BINARY))
GROUP BY CAST(record_type_name AS BINARY), dictionary_snapshot_status ORDER BY amount desc
